name: session-band
description: Band above the prompt: turn number, output speed, turn and session cost, prompt cache countdown, model, effort and context fill; notifies before the cache expires.

keepTurns.title: Turns kept when compacting
keepTurns.description: How many recent turns the band's compact button and `/session_data compact` keep word for word. Claude Code's own /compact and auto-compaction are not affected.

background.title: Band background
background.description: A color behind the band, to set it apart from the terminal: hex (#1e2430), a color name (blue) or a theme key (subtle). Empty keeps the terminal's background.
